bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
case "$(git remote get-url origin)" in *seigo-gace/create-videobot*) ;; *) exit 51;; esac
stage="$root/.worktrees/video-ui-e60b2076"
test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = "e60b2076fa5f87a58e7c7b1e3ee3706b06b1e552" || exit 62
test -z "$(git -C "$stage" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" || exit 63
git fetch --no-tags origin feat/assistant-ai-and-sales-core
sha="be4f34d04d346aa20be1765884186e907780f364"
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$sha" || exit 64
git -C "$stage" checkout --detach "$sha"
test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$sha" || exit 65
docker image inspect create-videobot:video-ui-e60b2076 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 66
docker build --pull=false --network none -t create-videobot:video-ui-be4f34d -f - "$stage" <<'DOCKERFILE'
FROM create-videobot:video-ui-e60b2076
USER root
COPY --chown=node:node src /opt/videobot/src
COPY --chown=node:node owner /opt/videobot/owner
COPY --chown=node:node sql /opt/videobot/sql
COPY --chown=node:node web /opt/videobot/web
USER node
DOCKERFILE
docker run --rm --pull never --network none --read-only --entrypoint node -v "$stage/test:/opt/videobot/test:ro" create-videobot:video-ui-be4f34d --test test/creatorUi.test.mjs test/creatorWizard.test.mjs test/creatorBot.test.mjs test/managementFee.test.mjs test/pgStarsLedger.test.mjs
echo VIDEO_UI_BE4_IMAGE_FOCUSED_TEST_PASS
